messages.author: 68ea602ee745cb2a
messages.subject: Zoom in images - 2d data
parts:
Hi, 

I am digitizing landmarks in 2d images with comand ''> digitize2d'' in Geomorph Package. 
But I need zoom im my image, because some structures are small. Someone know how do it?

Note: Sorry about my English. 
I'm Brazilian and Master Degree student in Animal Biology of Federal University of Espirito Santo.

Thanks!

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Zoom in images - 2d data
parts:
Mateus,

If I´m not mistaken, this is not a possibility in digitize2d.

At any rate, we recommend using stereomorph for digitizing, which is much more flexible than geomorph functions. You can get started on it by looking at the author´s page and the tutorials he provides, they are very helpful. There you do have the possibility of zooming in, as well as a much more friendly user interface. Here is the link to Aaron´s page: https://aaronolsen.github.io/software/stereomorph.html

Hope this helps

Antigoni
